name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties, created by Common Paper.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, created by Common Paper.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement for engaging a design partner to collaborate on and provide feedback for a product still in development, created by Common Paper.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: An agreement defining service level commitments, intended to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA).

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A standard agreement for engaging a vendor to perform professional services, such as consulting, implementation, or custom development work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: An agreement governing the processing of personal data between a data controller and a data processor, created by Common Paper.

name: Software License Agreement
description: A standard agreement for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software, created by Common Paper.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A standard agreement for structuring a business partnership between two companies, created by Common Paper.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: An agreement governing the handling of protected health information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate under HIPAA, created by Common Paper.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term agreement allowing a prospective customer to trial or evaluate a product or service before committing to a longer-term deal, created by Common Paper.

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum for governing the use of artificial intelligence features within another commercial agreement, created by Common Paper.
